Why Choose Aptive

We are pest control nerds at heart.

Learn more about the Aptive difference

Proactive protection

We analyze millions of pest data points across neighborhoods, migration activity, and weather shifts to help you stay ahead of pests.

Expertly trained professionals

Insured, licensed, and background-checked technicians using Aptive's ProAct Inspection™ to ensure a thorough treatment of your home with every service.

No hidden fees

Transparently priced plans with no surprise charges; any optional add‑ons are disclosed up front.

Smarter service

Personalized treatments tailored to your home and location for the right level of protection every visit.

Learn more about the Aptive difference

The smartest pest control is proactive. Our data powered approach helps protect your home year round. 

View our smarter plans

The Aptive Promise

When you choose Aptive, you’re choosing pest control you can trust. No hidden fees. Transparent pricing and plans.

And if pests come back, so do we at no extra cost....simply put, we'll handle it!

Kick pests to the curb with one simple call

No obligation — we'll walk you through next steps.

We’ll get back to you in as little as 15 minutes.

(Within business hours)

Thank You!

A pest control specialist will contact you shortly to build your custom plan.

What happens next:

  1. A specialist reviews your info
  2. We call or email you within 2 hours
  3. You get a customized plan with no obligation

What to expect in your pest control service

Intelligent protection. Friendly service professionals.

1. Inspect

Our ProAct Inspection™ treats every visit with the same care and attention as the first. We thoroughly inspect your property.

2. Customize

We tailor our treatments to what is happening in and around your home, helping to keep you one step ahead of pests.

3. Communicate

We share a clear pest diagnostic with notes, photos and next steps to ensure you're always kept well informed about your home's pest activity.

    Frequently asked questions

    Everything you need to know about Aptive Pest Control Services.

    What pests does Aptive treat for?

    Aptive provides year-round protection against common household pests, including ants, cockroaches, spiders, rodents, mosquitoes, ticks, fleas, and stinging pests.

    Our treatment plans are customized to your home, location, and season to address active pest concerns and help reduce future pest activity.

    Is Aptive pest control safe for my pets?

    Aptive uses EPA-approved products and follows all guidelines for appropriate use. All pets should be secured and kept away from the treated area during your appointment. Our technicians will not enter fenced areas where pets are visibly present. Once treated areas are dry, they meet most applicable safety standards under pesticide labels.

    How do I get started with Aptive Pest Control?

    Getting started is easy–call us at (877) 814-2194 to speak with a local expert. We serve over 6,000 cities across North America and are ready to help protect your home.

    What locations does Aptive serve?

    Aptive provides residential pest control services in 6,000+ cities across 37 states throughout the United States. We serve homeowners in major metropolitan areas and surrounding communities, delivering customized pest control solutions tailored to regional pest activity and seasonal pest pressures.

    You can view our full service area and check availability at https://aptivepestcontrol.com/locations/.

    Can I customize my Aptive service plan?

    Yes. Aptive can tailor a pest management plan that fits your home’s specific needs. From selecting the right plan tier to adding specialty services, we work with you to build the most effective protection for your property.

    What cities are experiencing the most activity from summer pests?

    According to the Aptive Summer Pest Report: Dallas, Tulsa, Memphis, San Jose, and Atlanta are the top cities predicted to experience summer wasp activity.

    *350,000+ recommendations based on combined 4 and 5 star reviews across verified review platforms including Google, Trustpilot, and Yelp.
